rules.description: Ensures all active JuvenileJusticeFacility and NotJuvenileJusticeFacility StatVars (excluding pre-2022 LimitedEnglishProficiency) within each input split share the same latest observation date (MaxDate).

Verifies that every StatVar in each input split meets its expected latest observation date (2012 for 2010-2012 non-JJ StatVars, 2016 for the 2016 split, 2021 for pre-2022 LimitedEnglishProficiency JJ/NotJJ StatVars, and >= 2024 for active 2018_onwards StatVars).

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MinDate, MaxDate, CASE WHEN StatVar NOT LIKE '%JuvenileJusticeFacility%' THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2012 WHEN CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) = 2016 THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2016 WHEN CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) >= 2018 AND StatVar LIKE '%LimitedEnglishProficiency%' THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2021 WHEN CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) >= 2018 THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2024 ELSE FALSE END AS is_fresh FROM stats UNION ALL SELECT 'EMPTY_STATS' AS StatVar, '' AS MinDate, '' AS MaxDate, FALSE AS is_fresh WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stats)
